title: Quality Assurance Engineer · Payments & Banking Test Automation
summary: I'm a Quality Assurance professional with 4+ years of experience testing digital payment and banking applications across functional, regression, integration, API and performance testing. I automate regression suites with Selenium WebDriver, Python and PyTest, validate APIs and backend data with Postman and SQL, and load-test with JMeter. I work closely with developers in Agile/Scrum teams to catch defects early and ship reliable releases.
